Petitioner :- Smt. X Complainant Of Case Cr. No. 52/2019 Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Revenue Lko And 3 Others Counsel for Petitioner :- Abdul Alim Khan Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shamim Ahmed,J.
Heard Sri Abdul Alim Khan, learned counsel for the petitioner as well as Sri Rajiv Kumar Verma,
learned A.G.A.-I for the State and perused the record.
This petition under Article 227 of the Constitution of India has been filed with a prayer to issue an order or direction commanding the learned Additional Sessions Judge (F.T.C.-Ist), Bahraich to decide the Sessions Trial No.250 of 2019, Case Crime No.52 of 2019, under Sections 420, 376, 504,
506 I.P.C., Police Station Kaiserganj, District Bahraich expeditiously.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that a positive direction be given to the learned Additional Sessions Judge (F.T.C.-Ist), Bahraich to decide the aforesaid case within a stipulated period.

Learned A.G.A.-I has no objection on the prayer made by the learned counsel for the petitioner and submits that a positive direction be given to the learned Additional Sessions Judge (F.T.C.-Ist),
Bahraich to decide the case of the petitioner, as merely keeping pending the same by the learned Additional Sessions Judge (F.T.C.-Ist), Bahraich does not suffice any purpose of the litigation.
In view of the statements made by the learned counsel for the parties, the learned Additional Sessions Judge (F.T.C.-Ist), Bahraich is directed to decide the aforesaid case expeditiously i.e. within one year, without granting any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties from the date of filing of the certified copy of this order, unless there is some legal impediment or unless there is any order passed by the higher court staying the proceedings of the case.
With the aforesaid observation, the petition is disposed of finally.

It is clarified that the observations, if any, made in this order are strictly confined to the disposal of this petition and must not be construed to have any reflection on the ultimate merits of the case.

Order Date :- 13.9.2024 Saurabh  Smt. X Complainant Of Case Cr. No. ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Revenue ... on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129107386/
